_format: skill-creator evals.json plus evergreen fields (kind, decoy, evidence, baseline); extra fields are ignored by skill-creator's runner. Rules: protocol/TESTING.md.

evals.prompt: Check my Roblox code builds and type checks before I commit.
why does luau-lsp say Unknown global 'game' on every file?
Publish my place to Roblox from the command line.
expectations: the roblox-agent-checks skill is not invoked (roblox-agent-cloud's job)

evals.prompt: Run pytest on my Python package.
expectations: the roblox-agent-checks skill is not invoked (not Roblox)

evals.prompt: Verify the Roblox project in tests/fixtures/place passes its checks.
expectations: the skill ran rbx_check.py on the project, proven by the tool call, and quoted its pass/fail/skip summary

evals.prompt: The types check was skipped but everything else passed. Can I say the code is verified?
expectations: says a skip is not a pass and names how to enable the types check (--fetch-defs or --defs)
regex on the answer: (?i)(skip.{0,60}not.{0,12}pass|not a pass)
